claim: A full local round starts without an account or payment.
sandbox: fresh browser context; start the real solo mode and assert active play without an identity or payment step

claim: A 90-second round reaches an actual win or loss end screen.
where: game timer, how to play, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; fixed 60 Hz simulation accelerated 18 times; assert 01:30 start, winner, final score, and focused restart

claim: Play again resets the timer and both scores.
sandbox: complete a deterministic run, choose Play again, and assert 01:30 and 0–0 during active play

claim: Capturing a relay adds two points.
sandbox: seeded core state; move a player through an active relay and assert an observable two-point increase and relay turnover

claim: A trail collision gives one point to the other player.
sandbox: seeded core state; drive Player 1 into Player 2's existing trail and assert Player 2 gains exactly one point while Player 1 respawns

claim: A dash briefly stops drawing and crosses a trail without a collision.
sandbox: seeded core state; drive a dashing player through an existing opposing segment and assert the player remains active without adding a trail point

claim: Trails are temporary and leave the arena after their lifetime.
sandbox: seeded core state with an aged trail point; advance one fixed step and assert the point is no longer present

claim: Solo mode has a moving bot, and two-player mode accepts separate keyboard controls.
sandbox: fresh real game; observe bot movement, switch to local mode, then assert A and Arrow Left turn different players

claim: Player 1 can use J and L to steer and I to dash after changing the key setting.
sandbox: fresh real game; choose J/L/I, start a round, and assert J changes heading while I starts a dash

claim: An active local round pauses with the Pause button, P, or Escape and resumes without resetting.
sandbox: fresh real game; use all three pause entries, assert the native pause dialog and paused state, then resume the same round

claim: Sound, reduced-effects, assist, and Player 1 key settings stay on this device.
sandbox: fresh real game; change all four controls, reload, and assert each restored value

claim: With Sound on, captures and collisions play short tones.
sandbox: mock Web Audio output; play capture and collision events and assert distinct oscillator tones are started

claim: Reduce effects removes control movement and touch vibration.
sandbox: fresh real game with a vibration fixture; enable the setting, assert hovered controls do not move and touch input does not vibrate, then disable it and assert vibration returns

claim: Assist mode slows trails and adds collision space.
sandbox: paired seeded core states; advance normal and assist play near the same trail and assert assist moves less and avoids the near collision

claim: An active round recovers after a refresh within 20 seconds.
sandbox: fresh real game; advance play, reload immediately, and assert playing state and elapsed time continue rather than reset

claim: The sample never reads or changes saved game data.
where: sample banner, release scope, privacy, README
sandbox: preseed real settings, a valid active round, an online key, IndexedDB, and OPFS; enter sample in one click, change sample settings, reset, and assert every real record and storage namespace is unchanged

claim: The sample starts at 4–2 after three captures with visible trails, three relays, and 56 seconds left; Reset demo restores that state.
sandbox: fresh sample page; observe its score and clock, inspect the rendered sample state, advance briefly, reset, and assert scores, captures, trails, relays, and clock return

claim: Preset reactions appear locally and in the same online room.
sandbox: fresh local game and two independent online browsers; send a preset reaction and assert the visible reaction text in each promised recipient

claim: The game makes no analytics, advertising, or third-party runtime requests.
sandbox: fresh context; record requests through sample and online room creation; assert every request goes only to the static origin or its product-owned room service

claim: Clear saved game data removes settings, the active round, and online room keys from this browser.
sandbox: seed all three storage record types, confirm the privacy dialog, and assert no Linebreak Clash browser key remains

claim: Solo and local rounds work offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; await service-worker control, set the context offline, reload, and start both advertised modes

claim: The arena renders at least 50 frames per second in the documented mobile browser profile.
sandbox: fresh 390×844, 2x DPR, touch-enabled Chromium context; run solo for three seconds and measure requestAnimationFrame throughput

claim: Touch controls steer a mobile round, and every link or control has a target at least 44 by 44 pixels.
sandbox: fresh 393 px touch context; steer an active round with the labelled control, then measure every visible link and button on the game, sample, privacy, terms, and online pages

claim: Two to four players on separate devices can finish the same 90-second room and start a shared rematch.
sandbox: four independent browser contexts create and join a real room, assert its 90-second duration, finish the accelerated test run with one shared result, and start a zero-score rematch

claim: Copy invite puts the current room link on the device clipboard.
sandbox: fresh online host with granted clipboard permission; create a room, choose Copy invite, and assert the clipboard contains that room URL

claim: Online rooms need no account and offer preset reactions instead of open chat.
sandbox: fresh online host; create a room, assert no visible writable text field remains and exactly the three preset reaction controls are available

claim: The online room service decides scores, collisions, positions, and time; browsers only send steering and dash input.
sandbox: authenticated raw room client sends forged score, position, collision, and clock fields alongside input; assert the next server snapshot retains server-controlled values

claim: Online play sends a chosen name, room code, and controls; the room service sends scores, timer, and room state back.
sandbox: fresh two-client room; record create, WebSocket send, and WebSocket receive payloads, then assert the documented client fields and server snapshot fields

claim: A dropped online player can rejoin the active room for 20 seconds.
sandbox: two independent browser contexts start a real room; drop one client for just over 19 seconds, then load its stored room key and assert it rejoins the active round before the 20-second limit

claim: Online room state survives a room-service restart and expires after 24 hours without activity.
sandbox: real SQLite file; start an active room, restart the service and reconnect, then age the record past 24 hours and assert it is absent after another restart
